svg.title: Pacific North Equatorial Countercurrent: OSW editorial reference-route candidate
svg.desc: Equirectangular schematic. Approximately 5000 km. Declared east-central Pacific study reach from 140 W to 95 W. Gates truncate a larger current; western Pacific inflow and coastal redistribution east of 95 W are excluded. Intermediate bends are editorial connections among section descriptions, not a reconstructed continuous axis or parcel trajectory. Source describes regional geography; OSW selects the drawn route. No measured current axis.
svg.text: OSW approximate 140 W to 95 W study reach — candidate
Dashed: nominal route · pale: 81 editorial scenarios
Not an observed axis or statistical confidence interval
Source: Johnson et al. (2002); OSW selects vertices
Equirectangular OSW atlas ground · scientific review pending
